verdict.rationale: Keycloak's Server Administration Guide explicitly documents first-class WebAuthn/passkey support, including loginless WebAuthn, conditional UI/autofill, and passkey mediation (kc-supp-passkeys), which directly satisfies the passkey/WebAuthn portion of the story. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of magic links or email OTP as sign-in methods — only general TOTP/2FA account management is referenced (keycloak-docs-13, keycloak-docs-51), leaving that part of the story unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented magic-link sign-in flow, email OTP as a passwordless authenticator, and independent/community confirmation of passwordless UX beyond WebAuthn.
